senses.gloss:
Maudgalya, ‘descendant of Mudgala,’ is the patronymic of
several persons, Nāka,^1 Śatabalākṣa,^2 and Lāṅgalāyana.^3 A
Brahmacārin of the name is mentioned in the Gopatha
Brāhmaṇa^4 as disputing with Glāva Maitreya.
1) Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa, xii. 5, 2, 1;
Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad, vi. 4, 4;
Taittirīya Upaniṣad, i. 9, 1.
2) Nirukta, xi. 6.
3) Aitareya Brāhmaṇa, v. 3, 8.
4) i. 1, 31; Bloomfield, Atharvaveda,
110. Cf. also Caland, Über das rituelle
Sūtra des Baudhāyana, 35.
